skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-google-ads-new-customer-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to set up Google Ads bidding on revenue or profit from first paid orders in Lightspeed eCom. Check tracking and verify the conversion goal after you change it in Google Ads.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Google Ads bidding on first paid Lightspeed orders.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most scanner matches are Markdown, scoped setup reads, or documented conversion behavior rather than shell evaluation or host reconnaissance. The skill does direct agents to an external MCP service and advertises an unpinned installer. It also allows assistant handling of privileged Lightspeed credentials and lacks an explicit approval step before Product Metrics enables new conversion reporting.

remediation.issue: The workflow permits privileged Lightspeed credentials to pass through the assistant.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the chat exception and require direct entry in the verified Product Metrics app. Use an approved secret-entry flow if automation is necessary, and keep credential values out of prompts and command arguments.

remediation.issue: The MCP interface can execute authenticated operations against a remote service.
remediation.suggestion: Require the user to approve their verified Product Metrics endpoint and workspace. Use read-only access for diagnostics and restrict write access to approved operations.

remediation.issue: The installation example does not pin the package runner or the skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed installer version and an immutable skill commit, or provide a verified manual installation path. Do not run the installer without explicit approval.

remediation.issue: Secondary conversion actions can receive live order events without changing campaign bidding.
remediation.suggestion: Before enabling conversion reporting, confirm the store, destination account, event types, consent settings, and scope of the change. Keep validation reads separate from setup writes.

content.user_title: Set Up New Customer Bidding for Lightspeed
content.value_statement: A standard purchase conversion does not distinguish first orders from repeat orders. Use Product Metrics to report first orders separately and verify the Google Ads goal you choose for bidding.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status and identify incomplete steps.
Guide the merchant through Lightspeed eCom and Google Ads tracking prerequisites.
Check whether recent paid orders were classified as new, returning, or unknown.
Guide setup of separate new customer revenue and profit conversion actions.
Explain target ROAS for first-order revenue or profit and verify the goal after the merchant makes the change.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series in Europe or the United States, Product Metrics Pro, and a proxied Cloudflare storefront.
Requires a connected Google Ads client account and linked Merchant Center. The merchant makes primary goal and campaign changes in Google Ads.
Only paid orders with a confirmed new customer qualify. Orders from before the connection count as history but are not uploaded retroactively.
Conversion reporting follows configured consent. Profit reporting requires active additional costs and complete order costs.

use_cases.title: Check Setup Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether the store, gateway, consent settings, and Google Ads connection are ready before creating conversion actions.

use_cases.title: Pilot a New Customer Goal
use_cases.description: Compare first-order revenue and profit, choose a target, and pilot the selected goal in one campaign.

use_cases.title: Investigate Missing Conversions
use_cases.description: Review a paid test order and check whether customer history, consent, or missing costs explain incomplete reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Check What Is Ready
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my Lightspeed store in Product Metrics. Tell me what is complete and which steps I must do myself. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Check Order Classification
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my latest 20 Lightspeed orders. Report totals for new, returning, and unknown customers. Explain why an order can remain unknown without listing customer details.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Revenue and Profit Goals
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the first-order revenue and profit goals for my Google Ads pilot. Check whether the profit data is ready and explain what a 100% profit target means. Leave campaign settings unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Pilot Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed the goal for [campaign] in Google Ads. Verify the goal status in Product Metrics. Tell me where to confirm the campaign goal, target ROAS, and bid strategy. Do not change settings.

output_examples.input: Is my store ready to report new customer conversions?
output: The store connection is active, but conversion actions are not ready.
Finish consent setup and confirm the destination Google Ads account before creating secondary conversion actions.
Place and pay for a test order as a new customer, then check its classification.

output_examples.input: Why did my first-order test show revenue but no profit?
output: The paid test order was classified as new and reported on Product Metrics - New Customer.
The order is missing a product cost, so it does not qualify for the profit action.
Check the Lightspeed line-item costs and confirm that additional costs are active in Product Metrics.

best_practices: Enter Lightspeed credentials in the verified Product Metrics app, not in assistant chat.
Verify the destination account and consent settings before enabling reporting, then confirm that a paid test order is classified correctly.
Pilot one campaign and verify that only the intended purchase action drives bidding.
anti_patterns: Making both revenue and profit purchase actions primary for the same campaign.
Using profit-based bidding before checking product costs and activating additional costs.
Treating an unpaid or unknown-customer order as proof that first-order reporting is broken.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow supports Lightspeed eCom C-Series on the Europe and United States clusters.

faq.question: How does Product Metrics identify a new customer?
faq.answer: Product Metrics uses the Lightspeed new-customer flag and order history. It counts the first paid order for a matched customer.

faq.question: Do orders placed before connection count?
faq.answer: They count toward customer history but are not uploaded to Google Ads. A customer with an earlier paid order is returning.

faq.question: Which new customer conversion should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose Product Metrics - New Customer for revenue or Product Metrics - New Customer Profit for profit. Use profit only when your costs are complete.

faq.question: What does a 100% target ROAS mean on profit?
faq.answer: At 100% on the profit action, first-order profit equals ad spend. It does not include profit from later orders.

faq.question: Can the assistant change what my campaign bids on?
faq.answer: No. You change the primary conversion or campaign goal in Google Ads. The assistant can check the conversion action status afterward.
